highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and expands support for current desktop, mobile, and WebAssembly toolchains.
highlights_body: It restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments and refreshes native platform support for .NET 11 previews and Tizen 10.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156, including the current core fork maintenance updates.

bullets.lead: Linux system fonts restored for NoDependencies packages
bullets.detail: Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover fonts installed on the system.

bullets.lead: Current platform toolchains and native assets aligned
bullets.detail: Refreshes .NET 11 preview and WebAssembly native assets, adds Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 build coverage, and brings native GTK4 GPU rendering and pixel scaling to the gallery.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments
